abstract: Founded in 2015, the Ultra HD Forum (UHDF) is a dynamic platform dedicated to expediting the deployment of Ultra HD technology. This collective brings together thought leaders spanning diverse industry sectors, including broadcasting, service provision, consumer electronics, and technology vendors. The collaborative spirit of the Forum enables its members to tackle real-world challenges in implementing advanced media formats, with a shared goal of establishing viable solutions for widespread adoption.

authors.bio: Pat Griffis is the president pro tem at Ultra HD Forum (UHDF), Fremont, CA. He is also the technology vice president in the CTO Office at Dolby, Sunnyvale, CA, where he is charged with helping define future technology strategy for the company. He is a past president of SMPTE (2019-2020).
authors.name: Pat Griffis

authors.bio: Ben Schwarz is the communications WG chair at Ultra HD Forum (UHDF), Fremont, CA. He is an active consultant, analyst, marketeer, and blogger and is recognized as an international thought leader in converging media.
